agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.

networks.description: Turn a lecture into a slide deck. Upload or record audio, or paste a transcript, and the agents build, check and export the slides.
networks.name: deckcast
sample_queries: What are the key points of this lecture?
Build me a deck from the transcript, no more than 8 slides.
Check the slides against the transcript and fix anything that is not in it.

networks.description: Writes quiz questions from a lecture: given the topic, slide titles and a transcript excerpt, it returns multiple-choice questions with answers and the slide each question comes from.
networks.name: quiz_generator
sample_queries: Write 5 quiz questions from this lecture on photosynthesis.
Give me a quick quiz on the Calvin cycle.
Test me on the key points of this deck.
Make a multiple-choice quiz from these slides.

peer_policy.note: Calls only the quiz generator on this same site, after the visitor agrees in chat. The quiz generator is a sibling network in this repo; it receives only the request text the producer passes it, never the chat history and never private context. No other peer networks are called.
